# Lazy device statics with no re-arm hook, each with the reason it is safe.
# Generated by hand; tools/check_static_reset.py fails on an unlisted TU and on a
# stale entry (the TU now re-arms, or holds no lazy device static).
#
# Format: <path><two spaces><reason>

src/model/weight_upload.cu  g_warm / g_stager are pinned-HOST staging (weight_snapshot.h), g_upload_log is host-only; all three are nulled by the StagingGuard destructor inside Model::upload_weights_gpu before it returns, so nothing outlives the upload. The device weights it uploads belong to the model arena, not to these statics.
